negative_findings.description: No Slovak commercial bank in this cell was found to publish a standing, machine-readable 'card / ATM / POS KPI' page. Searches in Slovak for per-bank card and terminal counts returned annual-report PDFs, fee schedules and press items, never a structured KPI dashboard or open dataset.
negative_findings.result_summary: Card/ATM/POS micro-data exists only as prose or tables inside PDFs and press releases; no API, CSV or XBRL tagging of these operational metrics.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must be PDF/HTML text-extraction based with per-bank templates; expect irregular metric definitions and discontinued series across years.

negative_findings.description: mBank S.A., pobočka zahraničnej banky and UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia, a.s., pobočka zahraničnej banky operate as branches of foreign banks and were not found to publish a Slovakia-only annual report with SK card/ATM/POS figures; UniCredit's Slovak-language reports cover the combined Czech+Slovak entity.
negative_findings.result_summary: SK-specific volumes for these two players must be inferred from press statements, branch filings in the Register účtovných závierok, or parent-group segment notes.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Bank-by-bank decomposition of Slovak national totals will have a structural gap for foreign-bank branches unless a proxy method is agreed.

negative_findings.description: Automated fetch of the Tatra banka annual-report hub returned HTTP 403, and one guessed SLSP financial-indicators path returned HTTP 404 (the site appears reorganised toward /informacie-o-banke/investori/financne-ukazovatele).
negative_findings.result_summary: Both are hypotheses of bot defence and URL migration, not evidence the pages are dead; the underlying PDFs surfaced normally in search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The collector needs browser-like headers or a headless browser for tatrabanka.sk, and must resolve SLSP document URLs from the live index rather than hardcoding paths.

negative_findings.description: Slovak-language searching produced heavy noise from same-named or similarly-named entities: 'Prvá stavebná sporiteľňa (PSS)' returned for 'Slovenská sporiteľňa', 'Slovenská správa ciest' returned for ČSOB queries, and 'OZ PRIMA' for Prima banka.
negative_findings.result_summary: Ambiguous local terms identified and flagged as noisy: 'sporiteľňa', 'prima', 'výročná správa 2024' alone.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query templates must pin the full legal entity name and site: filter, or the corpus will silently ingest unrelated organisations' reports.

negative_findings.description: No separate Slovak bank entity 'Raiffeisen' with its own disclosures was found for this cell: in Slovakia Raiffeisen operates as a retail brand of Tatra banka, a.s. (RBI group). Searches for standalone Raiffeisen SK annual reports returned no independent SK bank report.
negative_findings.result_summary: Raiffeisen SK data is expected to be consolidated inside Tatra banka's reporting and RBI group segment reporting.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents double-counting Raiffeisen and Tatra banka as two banks when building bank shares of the national card/ATM base.

coverage_gaps.description: Pillar 3 / NBS Opatrenie 16/2014 disclosure documents were located for ČSOB SK and (an older year for) SLSP, but the current-year disclosure URLs for VÚB, Tatra banka, 365.bank and Prima banka were not individually located in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a targeted per-bank query set of the form '<bank> zverejňovanie informácií opatrenie NBS 16/2014 site:<domain>' and record one stable disclosure URL per bank per year.

coverage_gaps.description: POS/merchant-acquiring disclosures were only reached through VÚB's product page. Acquiring in SK is partly handled by specialised arms and processors (e.g. bank acquiring units and third-party processors) whose own disclosures were not searched in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend to per-bank acquiring/merchant-services pages and to the banks' subsidiary lists (e.g. SLSP 'dcérske spoločnosti') to find terminal-estate owners; coordinate with the processor/vendor cell to avoid overlap.

coverage_gaps.description: Each bank operates an official ATM/branch locator ('nájdi bankomat', 'pobočky a bankomaty') which typically has a JSON backend giving an exact live ATM count and geodata; none was probed in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each of the seven banks, inspect the locator page's network calls, document any JSON endpoint, and add it as a per-bank ATM-fleet time series (subject to ToS/robots).

coverage_gaps.description: The cell's named list omits smaller SK-active retail players that also disclose card/client numbers (e.g. Fio banka pobočka, Oberbank, J&T Banka, Privatbanka, ČSOB Stavebná sporiteľňa, Prvá stavebná sporiteľňa), which were seen only as search noise.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a second sweep for the long tail of SK banks and building societies using the NBS list of licensed banks as the actor map spine.

coverage_gaps.description: Several banks (VÚB, 365.bank, Prima banka) now publish the statutory annual report primarily as ESEF/iXBRL (XHTML), with PDF marked 'neoficiálna/informatívna'. Operational KPIs are in untagged narrative blocks.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an iXBRL-aware extractor that keeps both the tagged financial facts and the untagged narrative sections where card/ATM/POS counts live; keep the PDF as a parallel human-readable copy.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language mirrors of the Slovak bank reports and newsrooms (e.g. /en/ paths on slsp.sk, vub.sk, csob.sk) were not systematically mapped; only the Erste Group English IR portal was captured.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each bank, record the /en/ counterpart URL of the report hub so English extraction templates can be reused and terminology cross-checked against the Slovak original.

brief: Slovak commercial banks publish plenty of quantitative material, but almost none of it as structured data: for SLSP, VÚB, Tatra banka, ČSOB SK, 365.bank and Prima banka the recoverable card, ATM, POS, client and digital-transaction figures sit inside výročné správy (increasingly ESEF/iXBRL with 'neoficiálna' PDF twins), NBS Opatrenie 16/2014 Pillar 3 disclosures, sadzobníky/cenníky and dated press releases. Each bank keeps stable, crawlable document paths (vub.sk /document/documents/, tatrabanka.sk /files/archiv/, csob.sk /documents/11005/, 365.bank /media/, primabanka.sk /preview-file/), so a per-bank PDF-harvest plus text-extraction pipeline is the realistic collection method; tatrabanka.sk showed bot defence (403) on automated fetch and needs browser-like access. The two foreign-bank branches, mBank SK and UniCredit CZ&SK, publish no Slovakia-only operational report, leaving a structural gap that must be filled from press statements, branch filings and parent-group segment reporting (Erste for SLSP, RBI for Tatra banka, KBC for ČSOB, Intesa for VÚB), where Erste's Slovakia segment is the most usable quarterly cross-check. The biggest untapped opportunities are the banks' own ATM/branch locator JSON backends for live per-bank ATM fleets, and the acquiring/merchant-services side, which this pass only touched via VÚB's terminal product page.
